text: Janelle is an elven warrior who fought many clockwerk goblins in order to reach the enemy leader, a goblin tinker.

Jason Goodhutch is a human drink vendor located inside Westguard Inn in Westguard Keep in the contested territory of the Howling Fjord. He and his wife run the inn. Peppy Wrongnozzle frequently patrons his bar.
Jason Riggins is a human blacksmithing vendor located at Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.

Jean Pierre Poulain is a human located at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran. If you haven't started the Argent Tournament quest-chain, he will provide you with a free ride to the Argent Tournament Grounds on his Hippogryph.
Jareth Wildwoods is a night elf located in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Jamus'Vaz is an orc vendor located in Grommash Hold in the orc capital of Orgrimmar. He sells items in exchange for Justice Points and armor tokens.
Janice Winters is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at Hiri'watha Research Station in the Hinterlands.
Janella is a blood elf food and drink vendor found at Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands. Since the Ironmarch entered Azeroth through the Dark Portal, her whereabouts are unknown.
Jena Anderson is a human found on the road to Stratholme. She needs flour to make some bread and asks Martha Goslin for some. It's unknown what became of her.
James Vishas was a human member of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery.

Janric Moller is a human located in the Royal Library wing of Stormwind Keep, in the human capital of Stormwind. Janric is a student of archaeology under the renowned Harrison Jones, and can often be found attending his lectures in the library alongside fellow students Darnella Winford and Lana Dubing.

Jaracgos is an older blue dragon who left the Nexus, though he told Kalecgos before as he would feel guilty leaving without saying anything. He seemed very proper, addressing Kalecgos as "Spell-Weaver" even when he is no longer an Aspect. When he was younger, Kalecgos always looked up to Jaracgos. As he left, Jaracgos promised he would return on occasion.
Jara is an orc located at Challe's Home For Little Tykes in Nagrand.
Jay is a human located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.
Jeff Miller is a human located in the Town Hall of Lunarfall in .
Jasa is a jungle troll general goods vendor found in Warspear in Ashran.
Jen'thael Darkcloak is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Jaromir Gladetender is a night elf found outside Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Jawknee is an orc weapon vendor located at the Arsenal Absolute in Dalaran.

Jarl Throndyr was a vrykul located at, and the former leader of, Jandvik in Suramar. His body can be found among several dead Naga and is guarded by Brandolf. After gathering wood for the Beach Bonfire quest, his body is moved further down the beach where a funeral pyre can be built. If the player has also completed Band of Blood Brothers, the rescued Vrykul will also be present.

Jarl Velbrand is the leader of the Drekirjar. Along with Runeseer Faljar and Torvald, he could challenge Sigryn's claim to the throne of the Tideskorn. Sigryn fought him to prove herself worth of the Tideskorn throne. After being defeated, Velbrand yielded and said he and the Drekirjar would back Sigryn's claim to the throne.
Jay Prath is a human drink vendor who appears at the Bloodsail Buccaneers' beach party on the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore during Pirates' Day.
Jasper Whitewater is a human located at Gol Koval in Drustvar.
Jason Burns is a human located at Burnsie's Smithey in Boralus.
Jeb Johnson is a human located in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound.
Jameson is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Jane Hudson is a human located in Hudson Archaeological in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Jem was a human who died in the First War. He was the husband of Emma Felstone and they had three children: Jack, Jake, and Jem, named after him.

Corporal Jameson Keefe was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Fathomdasher, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.

Provisioner Jarrod was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Songswallow, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Jasper Beryl is a human that would be a part of Pandaria Treasure Society found in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Janice Lightbringer is a human who wrote to Fizzle Goblinseer, sharing her concerns about her husband's obsession with the Light.
Jen Buckhurst is a human located in Eckhart Lodge in Stormsong Valley.
Jandra Thornbough is a Kul Tiran human located in Zaralek Cavern.
Jhag is an orc located in Godan's Runeworks in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Godan and Kithas.
Jensen Farran is a human hunter trainer and bow vendor located at Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Jessica Chambers is a human innkeeper located at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

Jessi Falrevere is the daughter of Duke Falrevere (the ruler of the Bloodsail Buccaneers) and sister to the late Magrann. She is one of the four commodores of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Lester Zank and Jessi are the only people Duke Falrevere allows into his conﬁdence. Jessi Falrevere is in her mid-20s, and is a short, solid woman who looks as if she has a hint of dwarf in her veins. She is red-faced from shouting, drink, and sun. She seems to have been trying to make up for her gender since she came to terms with her pirate lifestyle, and can drink most men under the table. Jessi commands her ships in much the same way her father does, though she is more gregarious and has many friends among
Jhet Ironbeard is a dwarf vendor found in Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.
Jennifer Bell is the human innkeeper of Amberpine Lodge, which in the southwestern section of the Grizzly Hills.
Jeran Lockwood is a human found in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He is the master of the Thrust. During Death Rising, he was patrolling the grounds.
Jesse Masters is a human food vendor located at the Amberpine Lodge in the Grizzly Hills.
Jessica Sellers is a human ink supplier found in the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran.
Jin'yael was a Highborne wizard in Eldarath. At some point he made the Tablet of Jin'yael and the Rune of Jin'yael for all of the highborne of Eldarath to see.
Jenna Thunderbrew is a dwarf drink vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
Jergen was a human and inexperienced warrior who, along with the rest of his group of adventurers, was tricked by Oakwidow into assaulting a mine guarded by ancients.

Jerias Bloodvein is the undead captain of the Garrote. He is a member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. He has a grudge against Edwin VanCleef, due to VanCleef cheating Bloodvein, taking his gold and even a woman that Bloodvein had his eye on, and then killing him for good measure. He would later abduct Jimmy Blackridge and his friends Liam and Bram Woodring off the coast of Westfall, forcing the three of them into his crew to replace two dead Bloodsail Buccaneers that had been killed by the Defias Brotherhood. He was killed in a duel to the death by Jimmy Blackridge, after he and his crew attempted a raid on the Defias Brotherhood's headquarters, The Deadmines.

Jez Goodgrub is the eponymous "leader" at the Goodgrub Smoking Pit and has adventurers, sent by Sana Curtainfire, hunting frostsabers their queen, , as well as the eggs of chimaeras, so he can cook them. The chef will cook any game the locals bring him in exchange for coin.

Jin Warmkeg is a pandaren resident of Firebough Nook; he was one of the few villagers to survive to the attack of the sha-possessed yaungol, along with Sya Zhong, Ya Firebough and Old Lady Fung. All of them were rescued and led to safety to Shado-Pan Fallback by an adventurer.
Jesse Halloran is a human child located at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Jesi is an orc child located at the Dreadmist Camp in the Northern Barrens. She has a pet raptor named Ruby.
Jin'diza is a jungle troll general goods vendor located in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Huju.
Jeremy Collins is the art director of Warcraft Arclight Rumble and (former?) member of the World of Warcraft animation team.
Jermaine Buckey is a dwarf located above Gnomeregan in a tree, sitting under his brother Anton Buckey hiding from a Black Bear.
Jeramy McIntyre is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Jimmy Townsend is a human wanting to become a mage. He wrote a letter to Kirin Tor Monthly, worrying about his fiends telling him that he will become frail if he becomes a mage.
Jim Clark is a human located in Upton Borough in Boralus. He is having a picnic with Amelia Clark, while the children Eliza, Jack, Hannah, and Lilly are playing nearby, or go to see the dog Dori.

Jeremy Wood is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment. He was on the original World of Warcraft design team, being No. 30. After working on World of Warcraft for seven years (up until Wrath of the Lich King, he was transferred to work on Project Titan, which later became Overwatch.
Jim Wick is a human located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Jenny Swiftbrook is a human located at Driftwood Shore in Tiragarde Sound.
Jeorge Swiftbrook is a human located at Driftwood Shore in Tiragarde Sound.
Jill McHoonigan is a human located in Dead Man's Tale in Tiragarde Sound.
Jessamine Blakemore is a human innkeeper located in Vulture's Nest in Vol'dun.
Jimmy Roarke is a human located in Beacon Hill in Stormsong Valley.
Jenara Lightcrown is a blood elf vendor located in Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Jens Vilgrove is a human stable master located in Mage's Rest in the Azure Span.
Jenis is a night elf stable master located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.

Jessie Boomfist is a goblin monk trainer located at the KTC Headquarters on Kezan, where she is dueling a wooden flamingo, and in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara, where she sits atop the roof of the inn.
Jondor Steelbrow is a dwarf guild master located in the Commons in Ironforge. He works in the Ironforge Visitor's Center.
Jormund Stonebrow is a dwarf tailoring trainer located in the shop Stonebrow's Clothier, on the north side of the Great Forge in Ironforge.

Jordan Stilwell is a human located outside the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He was involved in the quest chain to create Verigan's Fist, the weapon for Alliance paladins. Jordan and Bosch Verigan were old friends and the mace was named in his honor.

Jorik Kerridan is a human rogue trainer located in Northshire Valley behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Jorik remained at his usual spot and was seen fighting two Clessington Attendants.

Jorin Deadeye is the son of the late Kilrogg Deadeye, the venerable leader of the Bleeding Hollow clan, and is the current clan's chieftain. Like his father and his Fel Horde counterpart Grillok "Darkeye", he has ritualistically removed one of his own eyes to see a vision of his death.

Johan Barnes is a human master enchanting trainer and vendor located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. He is located on the second floor in the Wizard tower. He is sitting in front of a bookcase.
Joj was a dwarf who helped Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver fight trolls in Khaz Modan. He died during the battle.
Johnny Yes is a human found on the southern tower of Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. He stands near Karen No, Willy Maybe, and Kibli Killohertz.

Joq was a human fisherman out of Theramore who traded with orc farmers for crops. Due to increased tension with the Horde, his fishing trawler Passion's Reward was escorted by footmen from Northwatch. After docking at Ratchet he got into an argument about the quality of the orc Klatt's crops. When the fight escalated to physical violence, the goblin bruiser Muzzlecrank was forced to arrest both men. After news of the arrest of Captain Joq reached Northwatch, Major Davin sent word to Theramore to ask for more reinforcements. A move that would be seen by the Horde as an act of aggression.
Jonathan Revah is a human found in the Caverns of Time instance, Escape from Durnholde Keep. He and Jerry Carter are commemorating a new tower built between Tarren Mill and Southshore.
Jonathan Jacobson is a pandaren member of the Shado-Pan found on top of the Serpent's Spine in Valley of the Four Winds. He is kneeling over the corpse of the Ik'thik Colossus.
Joanna Jolly is a human located at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.
Jodan is an orc blacksmith vendor located at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands. He sells a specific kind of armour made for the Dragonmaw Clan.
Joan Lorraine is a human located at Domination Point in the Domination Point scenario.
Joque Hemsley was a human who worked as a scribe in the Scribe's Quarters in Lunarfall with her assistant Cadia.
Jongan Haphurst is a human found tending to the Herb Garden in Lunarfall.
Joachim Demonsbane is a human paladin located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Jon Glacier is a human found aboard the boat The Dimension north of Temple of Karabor in .
Jonathan Stephens is a human located at the Lunarfall's Barracks in . He served no purpose until patch 6.1.0 when he started selling Bodyguard Miniaturization Device for 250 Garrison Resources.
Jonath Chainfist is a dwarf mining trainer found in Stormshield.
Jintha was the ruler of the Amani Empire during the Troll Wars.

John Yang (aka Sephuz) is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment. He worked on World of Warcraft: Legion, after previously working on Diablo III. Having joined Blizzard in 2011, he left the company in November 2021.
Jon Roberts is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Jonathan Newsham is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Jon Jafari is a human located in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Jolanna is a human located at the Broken Shore and Seething Shore.
Johnny was a human who along his family was turned into sheep by Cote "Shepherd" Metcalf's The Woolomancer's Charge. He was then killed as revealed by Craig Ryan V.
Jonathan Hayes is a human who is found dead in a cave of Glenbrook Hunting of Drustvar.
Jordan Stansfield is a human located in Falconhurst in Drustvar.

Jorun is a vrykul raider and leader of the Bloodwake clan. According to Vydhar, Jorun left the shores of Stormheim long ago with a fleet of ships, which some say consists of thousands of vessels. Known as the Bloodwake, he lives for the sole reason of raiding the Great Sea. Adventurers found one of his clan's drinking horns.
John Hight is the Warcraft franchise general manner, and formerly an executive producer and Vice President of the World of Warcraft team.
Joe Millard is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Joey Holton is a human located at Kennings Lodgein Tiragarde Sound. He runs around, playing with Maya.
John Eades is a human located in Layson & Sons Rigging in Stormsong Valley.
Johnathan Ebrills is a human located in Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar.
Jonathon Barnes is a human located by the road between Fort Daelin and Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.

John Chalfant is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment. Having been hired as a Cinematics Artist in 1998, he worked on Diablo II, Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, and World of Warcraft. Chalfant modeled and textured the human footman in The Prophecy, the first trailer for Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. He hid his initials, "jgc", on the cheek guards of the footman's helmet. The letters can be seen in the filigree design on either side of the footman's nose.
Johnny Awesomer is a human located in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Jornairr is a blood elf located in the Valley of Bones in Desolace.
Joseph Redpath is a human ghost found in Darrowshire in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Jubahl Corpseseeker is a human warlock located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. Despite being a human, his faction is Gnomeregan instead of Stormwind.
Juli Stormkettle is a gnome mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she is also present in the Hall of the Guardian.
Joshua Kien is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Joshua Maclure is a human drink vendor located at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. He sells various beverages and can be found just outside the Maclure house, near Pa Maclure.
Joy Ar'nareth is a high elf located at the top of Xylem's Tower at Bear's Head in Azshara. Alongside her was Rayan Dawnrisen.

Joseph Dirte is a human ghost standing at a shed on Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. He is normally invisible, and can only be seen by a player who has equipped the Spectral Essence item from the quest Kirtonos the Herald (quest), or a priest who has equipped The Eye of Divinity.
Julie Osworth is a human reagent vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Julie was injured during the Scourge assault at the Tournament Grounds.

Judge Malthred is a human paladin featured in DC Unlimited's World of Warcraft: Series 7 action figure set. He is wearing the Judgment Armor and wielding the Sulfuron Hammer. He has not yet appeared in any other media.
Julean Tremblay was a human innkeeper loacted in Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.
Julia Bates is a human located at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in Krasarang Wilds. She comes from the Eastern Kingdoms and has traveled to Pandaria to learn the ways of the Red Crane.
Joshua is a human boy located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He can be found behind the forge playing with his friends Bo and Mark.

Josah was a large, stockily built human with reddish blond hair and a member of the Twilight's Hammer cult. When Kirygosa was held captive in the Wyrmrest Temple, he and Zuuzuu were to transport her to Chromatus. Kiry killed him and escaped.
Jukke Deathward is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Joseph Winters is a human mage. He wrote a letter to Kirin Tor Monthly, about his parents disapproving of him becoming a mage.
Joseph Stephens is a human located at Stephen's Food Court in Boralus.
Joseph Furlong is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Julian Nichols is a human located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.
Josephine Rivers is a human located in a farm field near Twin Rivers in Stormsong Valley.
Jovani Gartside is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Joyia is a human located in the Whale's Belly in Tiragarde Sound.
Julie Auklight is a human located in her house in Mariner's Row in Boralus where she lives with her cats.
Julia Zelling is a human located at Tidebreak Summit in Stormsong Valley.
Judge Thelgram is a human ghost that appeared alongside other undead ghosts at Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills. Unlike the other ghosts, he wasn't hostile to the Alliance.
Juliet Stonehelm was a dwarf located in Dalaran. She sold shaman glyphs. On the World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic PTR, she is an orc.
Joseph Healer is a human located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. He can be found playing Hearthstone against Tristan Bailer.
Journalist Jessamine Spitz is a dwarf located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
Jutak is an orc weapon vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Jun'ha is an orc tailoring vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Juno Dufrain is a human master fishing trainer and vendor located at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
Juniper is a human ghost part of Captain Ellis crew. He informs players to wait for the Sister Mercy to arrive.

Justicar Julia Celeste is a human paladin, a veteran of the Scourgewar, and a champion and leader of the Order of the Silver Hand. Initially located at the Sands of Nasam in the Borean Tundra, she later moved to the Sanctum of Light beneath Light's Hope Chapel following the death of Tirion Fordring during the Battle for Broken Shore. At the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, she joined the ranks of the resurgent Knights of the Silver Hand under its new Highlord. As a member of the order's war council, she participated in the meetings for important decisions, and notably fought during the battle against Balnazzar and his demonic forces in Netherlight Temple.
Juwanamana is a jungle troll mage who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).

Ka'la is a Frostwolf orc follower found at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She joins up with Horde forces at Frostwall after Olin Umberhide is sent to aid the Frostwolves in culling the local gronnling population. She is described thusly in her contract: "A proven scout, Ka'la is also known for her unusual elusiveness." She is seen fighting in the Path of Glory when the Horde attacked Azuka Bladefury. She can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
Justine DeGroot is a human located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Justice Bentzel is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Junior Miner Joe is a human located in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound.
Justine Frost is a human located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde, appearing in both versions.
Kali Healtouch is a dwarf artisan herbalism trainer located at Thelsamar in Loch Modan. She is married to Ghak Healtouch.
Kam Deepfury was a level 25 elite Dark Iron dwarf mini-boss held captive in the Stormwind Stockade prior to the Cataclysm.
Kalynna Lathred is a human located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.
Kaerbrus is a night elf hunter trainer located at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.
Kallen Stanner is a human warrior trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

Kadavan was an ethereal mercenary hired by the death knight, Ragnok Bloodreaver, to capture nether dragons for him. Kadavan developed a device to carry out this feat, which Ragnok used to enslave a number of nether dragons. When the blue dragon Tyrygosa resisted the device, Ragnok threatened to kill Kadavan for his failure until the ethereal reminded him that he only promised that the device would ensnare nether dragons, which it had. In response, Ragnok ordered Kadavan to improve the device so as to capture Tyrygosa as well. Kadavan readily complied. During Ragnok's attempt to seize the Dark Portal, Tyrygosa captured Kadavan and demanded to know how to shut off the device and free the capti
Kaldorei Spirit is a ghost of a night elf at Lake Kel'theril in central Winterspring. He is one of three spirits that are visited to figure out the curse of Zin-Malor. The other two are a and a .
Kand Sandseeker is a dwarf located at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands. He also appears inside Uldaman.

Kaitlin is a human girl located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She can be found walking in circles around two tree stumps in the middle of the camp, near Marshal Patterson, with her pet pug Mr. Woofles.

Kaelis Sunsoar is a blood elf (judging by his paladin attire, presumably a Blood Knight) and the second-in-command of the Reliquary excavation at the Ruins of Ogudei, under Belloc Brightblade. Given the presence of other Blood Knights both wearing the Reliquary tabard and protecting the Reliquary's scouts and magi in the area, he is presumably their commander. Kaelis is found next to Melia Sunsoar, channeling his portal out of the ruins. The two are probably related.
Kanath is an orc stable master located at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Kagoro is an orc located at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. He appears after Suspicious Hoofprints (Horde) is turned in.
Kage Satsuke is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Kalandra Starhelm is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . Can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Kalgor Foeslayer is an orc that patrols near Dreadmaul Post.
Kadraes Featherwind is a night elf found at the night elven camp in Stormshield.

Kagra was a proud loyal orc warrior of the Frostwolf clan, who greatly respected Durotan. However following the loss of their home from a volcano eruption and Durotan's refusal to join the , her mate Nokrar would reluctantly challenge his Chieftain. Though winning Durotan would refuse to kill Nokrar arguing that too many Frostwolf lives had been lost. Nokrar and indeed Kagra herself were still convinced to join the Horde and would take their family and leave. This would lead to Durotan giving chase to prevent the loss of Frostwolf lives. Kagra and her children would be rescued but Nokrar was already killed and eaten by the Redwalkers, a fact that would horrify Durotan. Kagra would later part

Kaelyn Vineminder is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #121 - Kaelyn Vineminder *Class Starter 2013: Alliance Rogue #15 - Kaelyn Vineminder
Kane Carlyle is a human located in Anyport in Drustvar. He has a crush on Xun Xun Sweetflower.

Kakushan was a great vrykul warrior who laid waste to Stormscale naga villages with his friend Ivagont in Darkshore. They drank the blood of their enemies and crafted armor from their skins. By virtue of Ivagont's protection, the two remained unscathed.
Kaduz is an orc located in . He is the husband of Dulga. He went missing.
Kaln Vilehoof is a tauren death knight seen speaking with Vik Mournblade in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Kaara is a Mag'har orc located at Brewfest Grounds in Durotar.
Kaela Godwin is a human located in Beacon Hill in Stormsong Valley. She can be seen healing Injured Militia.
Kaennissavia is a blood elf located at Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
Kalithumos is a human located at the Little Scales Daycare in Valdrakken. He can be found reading stories for a large group of Attentive Whelps.
Kadros Icewrath is a night elf located in the Vault of the Incarnates as part of The Primalist Council encounter.

Kash'drakor was a famous Frostwolf clan orc. The axe Serathil was crafted for him and used during the Blood River war which ended in the annihilation of the Dark Scar clan. He died at an unknown point and his last living relative is his son, Nazgrel. The axe was retrieved by an ogre warlord named Kor'gall, before Rexxar killed him and took the axe.

Karolek is an orc artisan leatherworking trainer located in the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Morgum in front of the building. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Katie Hunter is a human horse breeder and horse vendor located in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She can be found at the stables in the northern part of the camp, near Randal Hunter.
Kawnie Softbreeze is a tauren general goods vendor located in Camp Narache in Mulgore.
Karm Ironquill is a dwarf mining vendor located in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Kat Sampson is a human leather armor vendor located at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.
Kartosh is an orc warlock trainer located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Katrina Turner is a human located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris. She is involved in the management of the Thunderdrome. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Karrus was a legendary human warrior. He wielded the Arcanite Shield of Karrus during the first campaign against the orcs in Lordaeron. It was often said that no arrow made could fell Karrus, and indeed, he was finally brought down by a swarming attack of orcish foot soldiers. Although he fell in battle, his shield was preserved, and since that time several examples of its type have been created. All bear his name and a bas relief image of his face in reverence to this great hero.
Karynna is a blood elf armor vendor in the Sun's Reach Armory of the Isle of Quel'Danas. She sells Season 1 armor in exchange for Tier 4 Tokens of the Fallen Defender.

Karius was an old night elf refugee who had been attacked by a felbeast while looking for food. He managed to survive due to having previously served Black Rook Hold. Tyrande was able to heal him of the beast's poisons, and Karius and his wife greatly thanked her for it. It is unknown whether he or his wife survived the War of the Ancients.
Kat Sunflower is a high elf atop the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. She occasionally comments on the spectacular view she has.

Colonel Kavdan was a member of Alterac's military during the time of the Second War. Kavdan was shocked when Lord Aiden Perenolde informed the gathering that the Horde was approaching, but shock turned to horror. Aiden had made a pact with the Horde and although there was protest from the likes of General Hath, it was Aiden who had the last word. Kavdan, Hath and the nobles of Alterac were forced to comply. It is unknown what happened to him after the war.
Karu is a young orc female who lives with her father, Kranal Fiss, near Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens.

Kardan is a Wildhammer dwarf from the Wildhammer clan who fought with Dougan and Voldana against the Horde during the Second War. When Dougan heard townsfolk were disappearing from investigating the cursed tower of Karazhan, he ventured off with Kardan and Voldana to rescue the missing villagers. The evils of the tower was too much and while Kardan and Voldana escaped, Dougan was left behind. Kardan and Voldana delivered the sad news to Dougan’s wife Adena. Yet so immense was her grief that her mind snapped and she became unfit to raise her twin baby girls. And so Voldana and Kardan decided to honor their colleague by raising the twin girls as their own. Kardan raised Lieren in Aerie Peak. W

Karga Rageroar is the leader of the Rageroar clan that assaulted Northwatch Hold during the Cataclysm. The helm Karga wears was fashioned from the scalp of Tolliver Houndstooth's brother, who died following an orcish attack on their ship as they and other Gilnean refugees attempted to reach safety. Karga was eventually defeated by Alliance adventurers sent by Northwatch to break the siege, who delivered his helm to Tolliver. He survived the attack and later renewed his assault on Northwatch during the Fourth War, where he was encountered by Alliance champions.

Katriedna is a member of the Spanish language CM team on the EU forums.
Kar Greyskull was a level 92 Kor'kron Commander orc located at Northern Barrens.

Karg Bloodfury is an orc warrior located in Grom'gar and a member of the Frostwolf Orcs. He is the captain of Stonefang Outpost. After being taken captive by the Iron Horde in Frostfire Ridge, he is liberated by his mate Lokra with help from the adventurers of the Horde. The group then goes on a rampage through Grom'gar to weaken its defenses and avenge their fallen comrades. He is seen fighting alongside Lokra at The Battle of Thunder Pass. He can later be recruited as a follower once the adventurer reaches revered with the Frostwolves.

Kayklee is a night elf general goods vendor located in the Wileywisp Den, on top of Sabermaw Bluff in Val'sharah.
Karam Magespear is a blood elf located at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

Katherine Proudmoore is the ruler of House Proudmoore, former Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras, widow of Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and mother to Derek, Jaina, and Tandred. Katherine became the Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras after her husband's death at Theramore, but later abdicated in favor of her daughter after the Proudmoores reunited both their family and their homeland after many years. From the capital of Boralus, Katherine ruled Tiragarde Sound.

Kelgar told Thrall of the corruption of the orcs due to the treachery of Gul'dan, and how the old ways had been so much better for the Horde (thus being the first person to introduce him to the idea of shamanism and the spiritual cure that the orcs needed). He created a distraction by fighting the guards, allowing Thrall to escape the camp. He was "demon-corrupted" with red eyes and, like many of the other orcs at the time, lethargic. Keina is a night elf bow vendor located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Kazan Mogosh is a dwarf food and drink vendor located in Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Keeg Gibn is a dwarf drink vendor located in Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh.
Kayren Soothallow is a Forsaken general goods vendor located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Keena is an orc trade goods vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

Keegan Firebeard is the leader of a band of Wildhammer dwarves in the Twilight Highlands at Firebeard's Patrol. He marries Fanny Thundermar during the Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding. On the , Keegan and his wife tend to the stables at Lunarfall, the Alliance Garrison. They are joined by Sky'reen, the daughter of the late gryphon Sky'ree and whose egg they received as a wedding gift. He traveled with his wife to the Dragon Isles. They are found at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Keep Watcher Kerry is a human innkeeper located in Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Keg Smash is a Brewmaster monk talent. It deals damage to the target and all nearby enemy targets, and reduces the cooldown of Brews by 4 seconds.

Kelantir Bloodblade was a blood elf Blood Knight. She trained with , and served directly under the military leader of Quel'Thalas, Ranger General . She was sent to oversee the blood elves aiding in 's attack on Theramore Isle.

Kaz Endsky is an orc death knight captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Endsky or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.

Kayn Sunfury is a blood elf demon hunter and prominent member of the Illidari. He is a loyal soldier and one of Illidan Stormrage's most trusted lieutenants. Honorable and demanding, as well as a fearless leader and a master strategist, he believes that cooperation and sacrifice are necessary to defeat the Burning Legion. Kayn follows Illidan's ideals to get the job done, no matter the cost. Kayn is one of two characters player demon hunters can choose to be their second-in-command, the other being Altruis the Sufferer, whose ideals and plans for the Illidari are incompatible with Kayn's own.
Kel'rikor is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Keera Emberblaze was an orc located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.
Kazruul is a fel lord that appeared at the Legion Invasion locations. He also appears during the Legion Assaults of Azsuna.

Keegan Alby is a Kul Tiran human guard of House Stormsong, located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound. He was protecting the young Lord Brannon Stormsong, but lost him when their town fell. The traitor Brother Conway held Stormsong hostage in the Stormsong manor, and a shameful and worried Keegan would try convince adventurers to rescue him.
Kayleigh Calder is a human located at the Tiragarde Customs Agency in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Kazul is a human located in the Stormwind Stockade. She has been imprisoned for impersonating Hogger, and her "costume" can be found next to her cage.
Keda Bloomblade is a night elf Sentinel and the protagonist of the short story "Stones, Moss, and Tears".
Keen-Eye Valindra is a night elf located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. She shares a table with Maelin Jadesong and both are speaking with Enkida about the similarities of their people.

Ker Ragetotem is a tauren warrior trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
Kelgruk Bloodaxe is an orc artisan weaponsmithing trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Keryn Sylvius is a human rogue trainer located in the upstairs section of the Lion's Pride Inn in Elwynn Forest.
Kersok Prond is a dwarf trade goods vendor located in Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Kelsey Yance is a human cooking vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn where he runs Good Food. He provides a Crate of Grade-E Meat for the quest A Giant's Feast, which doesn't sound very appealing and is apparently only 'suitable for revenge'.

Kenata Dabyrie is a human found in the Arathi Highlands. She lives with her two sons Fardel and Marcel at the Dabyrie's Farmstead. Genavie Callow wants their heads because they stole her only precious belongings. She was present at the farmstead during the events of the Battle for Stromgarde.

Keltus Darkleaf is a blood elf located on a crag west of An'daroth in the blood elf territory of Ghostlands. He has a bat named Whisper as a pet. As seen in quests related, he was sent sent to the Ghostlands by the Students of Shadows in order to spy on the nearby Night Elves.
Kelt Thomasin is a human found at Mo'grosh Stronghold in northeastern Loch Modan. Before the Cataclysm he was located in Farstrider Lodge.

Kelmarin was a high elf ranger who served under Sylvanas Windrunner's command during the Third War. He was one of the three scouts sent to investigate the Scourge army, the other two being Sheldaris and Vor'athil. While the other two had waited for Sylvanas to come with the bulk of the rangers, he returned to Sylvanas to inform her about the approaching army. Sylvanas knew him well, and knew his information was always accurate and detailed.

Kenneth Lamb is a Forsaken general goods vendor located just outside the inn in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills, on the right hand side if you are facing the inn. Shannon Lamb is likely his wife. During the Legion Invasions, he rescued by the adventurers. He was worried about Shannon.
